create_agents_composite: create an Agents composite that executes multiple Salina agents sequentially on a workspace
build_temporal_agent: build a TemporalAgent that executes an agent over multiple timesteps with a stop condition
create_copy_tagent: create a CopyTAgent that copies a workspace variable from input_name to output_name with optional detach
create_print_agent: create a PrintAgent that prints specified workspace variable values to the console for debugging
build_episodes_done_tagent: build an EpisodesDone TAgent that propagates done flags forward across all future timesteps
